name: Gobierno de Santa Fe Centro de Procesamiento de Datos
developer: Gobierno de la Provincia de Santa Fe
notes: Provincial government data center at San Martin 1339, Santa Fe; official project page describes construction of the main data center and supporting power/cooling procurement. DCD reported more than ARS 30m investment, over 200 sq m, and primary/secondary high-availability role.

name: Cirion ROS1 / Cirion Rosario
notes: Colocation data center in Rosario/Santa Fe market; directory sources list the facility as operational, and Cirion SOC summary lists Rosario (ROS1) among Argentina data center locations. Baxtel reports 1 MW and 9,354 sq ft.

name: DonWeb / Dattatec Rosario Data Center Manuel Belgrano
notes: DonWeb history says it built a Rosario datacenter for 800 servers in 2010; directory sources identify the Manuel Belgrano/Rosario facility at Cordoba 3753. RedUSERS reported initial US$1m investment and more than 1,000 servers at opening.

name: UNL Data Center Ciudad Universitaria
notes: UNL announced a 309 sq m Centro de Procesamiento de Datos at Ciudad Universitaria to house database servers and ensure service continuity. DataCenterMap later lists UNL Data Center at Ruta Nacional N 168 80.

name: Datalink SRL Totoras
notes: Inflect lists a Datalink SRL-operated data center at 1343 Avenida Maipu, Totoras, Santa Fe, with colocation, redundant power, cooling, and security features. Connectbase corroborates the Datalink SRL headquarters address in Totoras.

name: Complejo Juan Felipe Ibarra Data Center
developer: Gobierno de la Provincia de Santiago del Estero / Panedile
notes: Official Complejo Juan Felipe Ibarra page says the complex houses the provincial Data Center with a high-security vault room administering provincial digital information on special servers. Data Center Market reported the CPD was built by Panedile beside the complex and was intended to host provincial digital records.

name: Facultad de Medicina Data Center / Centro de Referencia de Medicina Nuclear
developer: Gobierno argentino / Gobierno de Santiago del Estero
notes: DCD reported national and provincial agreements for a faculty of medicine data center, described as the first northern Argentina reference center for nuclear medicine; no later operating confirmation found in this pass, so status remains planned.

name: Data Center TDF Ushuaia
notes: Company site lists housing, virtual servers, backup, cloud and remote-hands services and gives the Ushuaia address at Gobernador Deloqui 555, third floor. DataCenterMap describes it as the first/only data center in Tierra del Fuego and Patagonia Argentina; CUIT listing shows company registration in Ushuaia from 2018-10-25.

name: Hospital Regional Data Center capacity expansion
developer: Gobierno de Tierra del Fuego / Ministerio de Salud
notes: Provincial procurement resolutions refer to goods/services intended to increase installed capacity of a Data Center located in the Regional Hospital and to administration, maintenance and prevention of Ministry of Health data centers. Facility details and MW were not disclosed in searchable snippets.

name: Poder Judicial de Tucuman Data Center
notes: Official judiciary page describes guided visits to the recently inaugurated Data Center, calling it a key element for justice digitalization and an important regional/national reference. 2022 judicial-year remarks said the new facility would triple resources and support the Alberdi platform; REFLEJAR publication describes a TIER II-oriented high-performance data center project.
